_comment: Project settings for the post-merge QA agent, filled in for Spring PetClinic (Java, Thymeleaf, Cucumber + Selenium). Everything project-specific lives here so the script itself stays generic.
project_description: Spring Boot monolith with Thymeleaf pages: a veterinary clinic with owners, their pets and visits, and vets. Java packages: owner (owners, pets and visits: controllers, repositories, pages), vet, visit, model (shared base classes) and system (welcome page, errors, cache).
suite_description: Cucumber scenarios (src/test/resources/scenarios/*.feature) run by Java and Selenium in Chrome against the running application on port 8080. The application has no login.

test_data.title: Seeded clinic data (SQL inserts)
test_data.note: the ONLY data that exists at start-up; owner names, cities, telephone numbers, pets and vets are exact

prompt_vars.example_step: Fill the field named 'lastName' with 'Franklin' and submit the search form
prompt_vars.helpers_rules: reuse ONLY the steps defined in StepDefinition.java and GenericSteps.java (shown in the framework section); copy their wording exactly.
prompt_vars.auth_rules: The application has no login and no stored session. The data is reset every time the application starts.
prompt_vars.app_rules: - Pages: /owners/find (heading 'Find Owners', form id 'search-owner-form', field 'lastName', a LINK with the exact text 'Add Owner'), /owners/new (heading 'Owner', form id 'add-owner-form', fields named exactly 'firstName', 'lastName', 'address', 'city', 'telephone'; the submit BUTTON text is 'Add Owner'), the owners list (heading 'Owners', table id 'owners'), owner details (heading 'Owner Information', a LINK with the text 'Edit Owner'; the edit form's button text is 'Update Owner'), /vets.html (heading 'Veterinarians'). - Field names are the camelCase names above, never the visible labels ('First Name', 'Telephone'). - Exact messages shown by the application: empty required field -> 'must not be empty' (never 'may not be empty'); telephone that is not numeric or longer than 10 digits -> 'Telephone must be numeric, up to 10 digits'; the owner form also shows the hint 'All fields are required. Telephone must be numeric, up to 10 digits.'. - Filling a field ADDS to the text already in it: on the edit form first use the step that clears the field, then fill it. - On a form page with a validation error the entered values are inside input boxes, not page text: check them with the step that checks a field value. - Every step line must use ONLY the wording of the existing steps. Take element names, labels and headings from the provided markup only.
